result.notes:
This dataset provides aggregated annual counts of fatalities among personnel associated with United Nations missions. Fatality counts are grouped by incident year, United Nations mission, casualty nationality and type of fatality.  
  
Country identifiers, including United Nations M49 and ISO alpha-3 codes refer to the nationality of the casualties, not to the geographic location where the incident occurred.
